sections.title: Research Overview
sections.text: This study examines how urban consumers aged 18 to 45 choose, compare and buy everyday products. It combines a 350-respondent survey with four focus groups held in two cities during March and April 2026.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Identify the factors that drive purchase decisions
Measure price sensitivity across income groups
Map the role of brand trust and online channels

sections.title: Customer Insights
sections.text: More than half of the respondents name quality and price together as their main reason to buy. Promotions matter for a quarter, mostly among younger buyers.
sections.quote: Consumers reward quality first and price second; promotions win only when both are equal.
